summary: Completed testing of Smart Alerts v2 feature (iteration 18). Backend: 18/19 tests passed (1 skipped - no not_ordered alerts as seed data is recent). Frontend: All features verified working correctly. Smart Alerts section renders at TOP of dashboard with actionable alerts from real purchase data.
seed_data_creation: Using existing seed data. Backend generates 14 alerts from real purchase history: 6 price_increase, 8 cheaper_vendor, 0 not_ordered (seed data too recent for not_ordered alerts)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Smart Alerts v2 implemented and tested. New alert types: price_increase (old/new price, change_pct, vendor), cheaper_vendor (current/cheaper price, savings_pct, vendor comparison), not_ordered (days_since, last_date). Severity thresholds: price_increase (high >15%, medium >8%, low >3%), cheaper_vendor (high >20%, medium >10%, low >3%), not_ordered (high >21 days, medium >14 days, low >10 days).
